_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment, ADR-107 money hands off to shillinq
_meta.description: InboundPayable: money another app owes someone and asks shillinq to pay out (an Awb penalty for a late decision, a subsidy advance, a deposit to return). The app raises it with PayableRaisedEvent; finance approves it (expense against the payables account), pays it (payables against the bank) or rejects it, the app may withdraw it while it is still requested (PayableCancelRequestedEvent), and each step is posted to the app's callback URL, signed with the app's secret (REQ-IPY-001 to REQ-IPY-004, decision 192).

InboundPayable.title: Payable from another app
InboundPayable.description: Money another app owes a payee and asks finance to pay out.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every step of a payout is recorded: who raised it, who approved, paid or rejected it, and whether the app heard back.
